lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The high-intensity local maxima are arranged in structured vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots demonstrate a geometric spacing of approximately 2-3 spot diameters between each centroid within the vertical alignment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular macro-spots, creating a grid-like lattice where the spots serve as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a high-contrast luminance gradient with a light-reflecting dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, white, elongated appendage or tag is visible trailing from the posterior insertion point of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: There is a significant transition in pixel texture from high-density micro-spots on the cephalic region to lower-density, larger-diameter macro-spots on the lateral flank.
